attributes.board_name: DC Board of Veterinary Medicine (DC Health)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Approved CE; may be satisfied through approved internet CE courses
rules.new_licensee_rule: First-time renewal applicants do not need CE.
rules.alternatives: One-time transition to the birth-month cycle: 50% of CE accepted for licensees with less than 2 years on their license term (LGBTQ and public health hours still required).
rules.audit_note: CE certificates are uploaded at renewal; post-renewal audits possible.

topics.who: Cultural competency or specialized clinical training for patients or clients who identify as LGBTQ

rules.notes: Since June 16, 2024 DC licenses expire on the last day of the holder's birth month (odd/even renewal year follows birth year). Hours from the Board's 2023 renewal letter.
